sections.h2: Norsepower's installed rotor sails rose from 38 to 45 by Q1 2026

chart.title: Norsepower's rotor-sail count grew from June 2025 to Q1 2026
chart.sub: Rotor sails installed, Norsepower's reported figures.

sections.means: Norsepower reports 38 rotor sails on 22 vessels as of June 2025, and 45 sails on 25 ships by Q1 2026.
sections.todo: Check whether the 39 units still planned across 16 further ships are installed on schedule.

sections.h2: Wind-assist sail deliveries grew from 49 in 2024 to 63 in 2025

chart.title: Wind-assist sails delivered across all vendors were higher in 2025 than 2024
chart.sub: Wind-assist sails on ships delivered in each year, all vendors.

sections.means: DNV counted 22 ships delivered with wind-assist devices in 2024 and 24 ships in 2025, carrying 49 and 63 sails.

sections.h2: LNG led 2025 alternative-fuel orders, well ahead of methanol

chart.title: LNG accounted for 87 vessels of 2025 alternative-fuel orders
chart.sub: Full-year 2025 orders by fuel type, vessels. LPG is a partial-year snapshot.

sections.means: DNV counted 1,794 alternative-fuel-capable ships in operation as of August 2025, with 1,544 more on order.
